changelog:
**Important: Google Hotels endpoints no longer support listing details or reviews.**

- Updated documentation and skill scope to reflect that Google Hotels supports only search, availability, price, and cross-OTA price comparison. Listing detail and reviews endpoints are not enabled for Google Hotels.
- Adjusted tags and schema descriptions to align with updated support.
- Platform × endpoint support table added, clarifying which platforms are available for each endpoint.
- Removed all references and documentation for endpoints (`/v1/listing`, `/v1/reviews`) not supported by Google Hotels.
- Deleted redundant or outdated files (e.g., skill-card.md) for clarity and accuracy.
summary: Complete Google Hotels toolkit — search, availability, price and cross-OTA price comparison in one unified schema. Note: Google Hotels supports neither listing detail nor reviews. Install this when an agent needs broad Google Hotels coverage. Powered by StayingAPI.
